thread:
Maya P: quick sync 1 trace drilldown iteration. Follow-up from usability testing: users wanted clearer export wording, easier copy for correlation ids, collapsed stacks by default, and better keyboard nav for span actions. Figma: https://figma.com/file/def

Samir K: agree. prioritize correlation id as primary copyable item (pill) with copy toast + keyboard shortcut. Put single visible CTA and hide other actions under kebab. add aria-labels.

Toni L: microcopy choice: users kept saying 'bundle' because it included multiple files. I'm leaning to "Download error bundle" rather than "Export trace" so expectations are set.

Olivia R: product prefers consistent terminology: "Export" for CSV/tabular, "Download" for packaged artifacts. Recommend "Download error bundle" + helper text listing filenames. Also add brief security note about sensitive headers.

Maya P: header mock: [error icon] Error 0 0 correlation: ab12cd34 [Copy]. Summary row with timestamp, route, masked user. Primary CTA: "Download error bundle". Kebab: Open in Log Viewer, Copy Trace Link, Export Spans (JSON), Open Full Trace. Thoughts on order?

Samir K: for keyboard users, first kebab item should be "Copy Trace Link". add Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C to copy correlation id when panel focused. include aria-describedby for what the bundle contains.

Toni L: download dialog copy variants: Option A: Title "Download error bundle" Body "Package includes: spans.json, logs.log, request_headers.json" CTA "Download". Option B: Title "Export trace artifact" Body "Includes spans and raw logs for debugging." CTA "Export". Which is clearer?

Olivia R: Option A. explicit filenames help support and reduce ambiguity. include "Contains sensitive headers; share only with authorized personnel."

Maya P: accessibility issues from tests: screen reader announced "button" twice for the copy pill; long stacks overwhelm SR users so default collapse; keyboard users want Up/Down to move spans and Enter to expand.

DesignBot: checklist: - aria-live on copy toast - ensure download modal traps focus - skip-to-frames link for SRs - role="list"/"listitem" for span list - focus-visible styles on pill/actions

Samir K: perf note: some traces have thousands of spans. virtualize the span list and persist expand state only for visible items. debounce expand animation to avoid jank.

Toni L: stack frame micro-UX: show line numbers, add a small copy icon next to each frame that copies file:line (e.g., app/server.py:201). also add a "Copy stack" action to copy the full readable stack for tickets.

Maya P: side panel vs full screen: tests showed ~60% prefer side panel for quick triage, 40% want full-screen for deep debugging. compromise: default side panel with "Open full trace" in kebab that preserves selected span and scroll.

Samir K: add deep link pattern /traces/:id?span=:span_id. ensure truncated correlation id appears in friendly links. also preserve scroll position on open full trace.

Toni L: keyboard flow sketch: T opens focused trace; Tab order header 0 pill 0 primary 0 kebab 0 span list; Up/Down move spans; Enter toggle expand; Shift+Enter expand all frames for selected span. I'll add diagram in Figma.

Maya P: tooltip copy: "Copy trace link" seems succinct. pill should show truncated id (first 8 / last 4) and hover shows full id + hint "Press Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C".

DesignBot: tooltip accessibility reminder: tooltip target must be keyboard focusable and have aria-describedby; do not rely on hover-only hints.

Samir K: export nuance: when user clicks "Export Spans (JSON)", show ephemeral dropdown with options: Visible spans (default), All spans, Time range. defaulting to Visible spans prevents accidental huge exports.

InfraBot: infra needs bundle schema to stream zip parts. suggested filenames: spans.json, logs.log, request_headers.json, metadata.json. will add redact_headers flag for Private/Dedicated customers.

Olivia R: release notes draft: "Trace drilldown: clearer copy for downloads, accessible keyboard nav, collapsed stacks by default, side panel default with Open Full Trace option." schedule for next patch.

Maya P: next steps: 1) update Figma with final copy + side-panel and full-screen flows 2) add keyboard nav doc and ARIA spec 3) handoff virtualized span list impl notes to eng. will @Samir for ARIA review.

Samir K: I'll review ARIA and add unit tests for copy toast to avoid double announcements.

Maya P: thanks all 1 will run a small re-test next week and post results here. :thumbsup:
